==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Father Aereck]] in the [[Lumbridge]] church. ([[Lumbridge teleport]] can be used for quick travel to [[Lumbridge]]) {{Chat option|3 I'm looking for a quest!|1 Ok, let me help then.}}
*Go through the [[Lumbridge Graveyard|graveyard's]] southern exit and head to the hut west of [[Lumbridge Swamp]].}}

===Ghostspeak amulet===
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Father Urhney]] inside the hut. {{Chat option|2 Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.|1 He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.}}
*Head to the small room in the Lumbridge graveyard south of the church.
*Equip the [[Ghostspeak amulet]] and click the coffin, talk to the ghost. {{Chat option|1 Yep, now tell me what the problem is.}}}}

===The skull===
{{Checklist|*Head to the [[Wizards' Tower]], and climb down the ladder to the basement. (Use [[Necklace of passage]] to teleport to [[Wizards' Tower]] if you have one.)
*Search the altar, and you will receive a [[ghost's skull]]. A level 13 [[Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)|skeleton]] will appear, you don't have to kill it, just leave.
*Go back to the graveyard and use the skull on the coffin with it open.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
